quiz.problem: The two Final test questions test the same fact with the same answer: handoff out, prototype in a fresh session, handoff back. Cheat sheet line 303: "Mid-planning, and the prototype will be big".
quiz.fix:
Rewrite scenario-detour to test the return trip, in a fresh domain:
```test scenario-detour
You detoured out of a planning session to prototype a pet-sitting app's booking rules. The prototype session has settled the question, and the planning session is still open. What do you bring back?
- [ ] The whole prototype conversation, pasted into the planning session so nothing is lost.
  > That pours the prototype's tokens into the very window the detour was protecting.
- [x] A second `/handoff` file holding the verdict and the non-obvious lessons.
  > Right. The planning session gets only the answer, reads it from one file, and carries on grilling.
- [ ] Nothing: the planning session can read the prototype's files on disk when it needs them.
  > The files show what was built, not what you decided or learned. Hand the answer back explicitly.
- [ ] A `/compact` run in the planning session, so it has room for the prototype's results.
  > `/compact` summarises the session you run it in. It can't bring back anything from the other one.
```
This keeps the right answer at position b and stops it being the longest option.
